scope: Designer proposal, Design Version 0.1.0. Present means source/defs exist, not live acceptance. No current proof asserted. Archived dry-run inventory reconciled below.

historical_exclusions.removed_soundscape: Already cut by owner; no resurrection or new retirement recommendation.
historical_exclusions.removed_rime_road: Already cut by owner; later giant exposure is a separate future promise, not permission to restore road.
historical_exclusions.removed_rack_drip: Already cut by owner; ordinary melting water conversion remains separate.

proof_note: Historical November proofs are stale relative to this definition and cannot prove its new boundaries. All rows use missing: no matched proof of the proposed behavior exists. Historical success is recorded in NOTES.md, not upgraded here.

rows.what: Composed Baroque Biomes member, own source DLL/settings and EnvironmentalHazards type dependency; vanilla IceSheet worker, no custom world-placement feature.
rows.called_by: Biomes.compose.json consumes this member; About.xml and csproj load its types.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: The existing compose member supplies identity and load boundaries; no planetary placement feature.
rows.why: Designer decision: The existing compose member supplies identity and load boundaries; no planetary placement feature.

rows.what: Ice-only ground, dry weather table, explicit animal/plant densities, no farming camps/rivers/forage, authored resident rows and travel difficulty.
rows.called_by: BiomeDef supplies local terrain, wild spawners, weather manager and map conditions.
rows.serves: ordinary land
rows.why: Designer decision: Deleting ordinary ice ground, cold sky and sparse resident distribution defeats the plateau.

rows.what: Dorrak sealed grazer; krissek predator; vekkit scavenger; zhaaz ordinary predator/slush fiction; vrisk flier; tameable dovvik grazer; utikka prey; vhaulk colossus; murrek ambusher; ossivel herd. Real race/kind defs, cold bands, life stages, tools and cold-wax butcher yields; names do not prove special AI.
rows.called_by: RM_BlueDesert.wildAnimals and PawnKindDef generation.
rows.serves: ordinary life
rows.why: Designer decision: Deleting grazers, prey, scavengers or predators removes ordinary life; no animal is evicted.

rows.what: Per-kind starting charge hediffs and species radii; non-vhaulk death charges now gated by master/native switches. Adult charge radius independent of life stage.
rows.called_by: PawnKindDef.startingHediffs; pawn death hooks in BlueDesertLife.cs.
rows.serves: cold preservation → useful extraction → warmth/damage → blast
rows.why: Designer decision: Without native death charges, violent contact with living fuel stops participating in the same field-to-cargo hazard.

rows.what: Destroying Hump kills through the settings-gated part hook, which invokes the death charge; ordinary leg damage has no special kill hook.
rows.called_by: RM_DorrakCharge invokes ExplodeOnPartDestroyed, which calls Pawn.Kill and the ordinary charge.
rows.serves: ordinary life
rows.why: Designer decision: The sealed Swallower is defined by vulnerable fuel storage; deleting the wound response removes the explicitly ratified feeding/body adaptation, not just decoration.

rows.what: Additional settings-gated BigExplosion death action on krissek; shares class with campaign ascendant Burner. Distinct blast path from charge hediff.
rows.called_by: RM_Krissek.race.deathAction AND RUT_PropaneLakeFauna.xml RUT_BurnerAscendant; separate from RM_KrissekCharge.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: A second local explosion path duplicates the charge and makes a single death unreasonably hard to explain; retain shared class for the propane-lake consumer.
rows.why: Designer decision: A second local explosion path duplicates the charge and makes a single death unreasonably hard to explain; retain shared class for the propane-lake consumer.

rows.what: Blue-fire effecter gated on jogging, aggro or enemy target; shared always-moving variant for campaign ascendant Burner, with master/halo gates.
rows.called_by: RM_Krissek CompProperties_Effecter; HaloAlways is independently called by RUT_BurnerAscendant.
rows.serves: ordinary life
rows.why: Designer decision: Deleting visible oxidation erases the ratified distinction between the fast Burner and sealed grazers; retain the movement/combat tell, not an additional attack.

rows.what: MaxFlightTime/FlightCooldown and whole-body directional flip-book references and frames are present. Flight report is a state-only check; no unattended flight run.
rows.called_by: RM_Vrisk PawnKindDef flight frames and Core Pawn_FlightTracker.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: Deleting real flight makes the fiction false under the standing flyer ruling; a flier-shaped walking pawn fails life.
rows.why: Designer decision: Deleting real flight makes the fiction false under the standing flyer ruling; a flier-shaped walking pawn fails life.

rows.what: Heat-family killing blow/culprit detonates; kinetic/cold kill does not; living EMP triggers immediate kill/blast. Separate gates, saved EMP state and off-map guard.
rows.called_by: RM_VhaulkCharge invokes RM_HediffComp_HeatGatedExplodeOnDeath.
rows.serves: cold preservation → useful extraction → warmth/damage → blast
rows.why: Designer decision: The living cistern must obey its ruled heat/EMP distinction for the same containment decision to make sense; deleting it converts the colossus into an ordinary hunt.

rows.what: Saved stay/departure state; wild calm eligible pawn gets an edge Goto/exit job, retries when interrupted; arrival/departure letters and exit-job/edge guard avoid ordinary despawn letters.
rows.called_by: RM_Vhaulk CompProperties_VhaulkRoad; no rime-road producer remains.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: The already migratory giant needs an observable exit and reason; deleting its walk/notice would silently remove a native or leave a promised visitor permanently stalled.
rows.why: Designer decision: The already migratory giant needs an observable exit and reason; deleting its walk/notice would silently remove a native or leave a promised visitor permanently stalled.

rows.what: Palefloss, glassfern, chimeglobe and virr: small unsowable dark/cold-growing, fertility-independent native plants yielding cold wax, with per-plant blast shape.
rows.called_by: RM_BlueDesert.wildPlants and WildPlantSpawner.
rows.serves: ordinary life
rows.why: Designer decision: Without ordinary small dark-growing transparent native plants there is no hydrocarbon ecology; these are not cultivateable crops.

rows.what: Sparse admitted rimetangle: charge-bearing hydrocarbon plant, cold wax yield and foreign-ingestion effect; real source owns it here.
rows.called_by: RM_BlueDesert.wildPlants; shared PlantCharge.
rows.serves: ordinary life
rows.why: Designer decision: Ordinary roster flora with the same growth, harvest and charge behavior; deleting it would be an unnecessary roster edit, not a simplification of systems.

rows.what: KillFinalize damage triggers flame blast; ingestion/Vanish and harvest/cut KillFinalizeLeavingsOnly do not. Feature and master switches gate it.
rows.called_by: CompPlantCharge.PostDestroy on every local native plant.
rows.serves: cold preservation → useful extraction → warmth/damage → blast
rows.why: Designer decision: Without propagation through damaged neighboring fuel the signature becomes isolated boomalopes, rather than the owner's field becoming a bomb.

rows.what: Two consecutive warm long ticks trigger kill/blast; cool/off resets countdown; global threshold tunable. Countdown not serialized.
rows.called_by: CompPlantCharge.CompTickLong; save/reload currently lacks countdown serialization.
rows.serves: cold preservation → useful extraction → warmth/damage → blast
rows.why: Designer decision: Without a persistent response to sustained warmth, placing heaters among native fuel has no consequence.

rows.what: First warm long tick plays one-shot RM_PhaseCrack before the second detonates; cue toggle does not alter timing; SoundDef limits simultaneous copies.
rows.called_by: CompPlantCharge.PlayCrackCue and RM_PhaseCrack; settings gate currently changes audio only.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: Deleting warning removes the chance to stop heat and retreat; sound alone is insufficient for an offscreen warming stack, so readable state accompanies it.
rows.why: Designer decision: Deleting warning removes the chance to stop heat and retreat; sound alone is insufficient for an offscreen warming stack, so readable state accompanies it.

rows.what: Plant ingestion gives foreign eaters decaying, potentially lethal/explosive ButaneGut; native-marker immunity and ingestion gate; death blast also depends on native-detonation gates.
rows.called_by: All flora ingestion outcomeDoers call RM_IngestionOutcomeDoer_ButaneGut; RM_ButaneGut carries the shared death gate.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: Life cannot be hydrocarbon-only if ordinary foreign animals eat it as safe hay; native immunity and readable foreign illness prevent that dietary bypass.
rows.why: Designer decision: Life cannot be hydrocarbon-only if ordinary foreign animals eat it as safe hay; native immunity and readable foreign illness prevent that dietary bypass.

rows.what: Harvest/butchery product; warm ruin signal starts vanilla explosive wick when enabled; stack expands blast; priced/tradeable. Damage wick remains vanilla behavior.
rows.called_by: All local native butcherProducts and most harvestedThingDef entries; ruined signal calls RM_CompRuinedDetonator.
rows.serves: cold preservation → useful extraction → warmth/damage → blast
rows.why: Designer decision: Removing portable warm-reactive fuel removes the reason containment must continue after harvesting.

rows.what: Qeshra yields nutritive warm-reactive roe with cold-wax comp stack and animal-feed intent. No custom foreign-eater rejection; not a hard human-edibility ban.
rows.called_by: RM_Qeshra.harvestedThingDef; native foodType; ColdStorage has separate seal recipe consumers.
rows.serves: ordinary life
rows.why: Designer decision: Ordinary harvestable native food makes tending a tame native possible; deleting its cold-handled food role makes the food web and taming promise incomplete.

rows.what: Kethevar normal harvest yields wax; damage KillFinalize yields warm-safe pure-carbon stuffable char-lace when expansion enabled. Current gate covers any damage kill, not only heat.
rows.called_by: RM_Kethevar PlantCharge.killedLeavingDef; PostDestroy currently shares floraExpansionEnabled with retained plants.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: Stuffable carbon produced by destroying a plant is a separate manufacturing reward; wax harvesting and the signature work without it.
rows.why: Designer decision: Stuffable carbon produced by destroying a plant is a separate manufacturing reward; wax harvesting and the signature work without it.

rows.what: Lisqueth has static pink glower/beauty and wax harvest, alongside its charge behavior; no pulse.
rows.called_by: RM_Lisqueth CompProperties_Glower, not a pulse system.
rows.serves: ordinary life
rows.why: Designer decision: Static plant light is the ordinary visible plant appearance, with vanilla glower and no timing minigame; deleting it erases its authored nocturnal identity.

rows.what: Rare vashpuk yields six wax and resets growth to 0.2 for repeated harvests; large charge radius.
rows.called_by: RM_Vashpuk plant.harvestAfterGrowth and harvestedThingDef.
rows.serves: ordinary life
rows.why: Designer decision: Vanilla repeated harvest is this wild plant's ordinary fuel gathering behavior; deleting harvesting defeats its role as living fuel. No planting or powered tapping machine.

rows.what: Milelace mat, hazebell and longglass spire shipped with art, charge/ingestion/wax recipe and startup roster gate; delegated design choices already settled.
rows.called_by: RM_BlueDesert.wildPlants; RM_CarbonGardenGate controls roster; HazeBloom is separately classified.
rows.serves: ordinary life
rows.why: Designer decision: Retain the ordinary mat, bell and branching spire plants with the shared charge and harvest; removing their bespoke bloom leaves ordinary land/life intact.

rows.what: Saved last-Haze/open state, Long-tick Haze bloom, configurable post-Haze duration, mesh dirtying, open graphic and breath puff; live master/bloom gates.
rows.called_by: RM_Hazebell CompProperties_HazeBloom and RM_Plant_Hazebell.Graphic; independent of PlantCharge.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: Timed opening and vapor after Haze is a secondary clock; closed hazebells still supply ordinary flora and fuel.
rows.why: Designer decision: Timed opening and vapor after Haze is a secondary clock; closed hazebells still supply ordinary flora and fuel.

rows.what: Expansion four and Garden three removed independently from wildPlants at startup when their settings are off; no removal of defs or already-standing plants.
rows.called_by: Startup RM_BlueDesertFloraGate and RM_CarbonGardenGate; settings UI and ExposeData.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: Deleting roster and per-feature controls violates the inherited Settings floor; retaining flora does not require their char-lace or bloom behaviors.
rows.why: Designer decision: Deleting roster and per-feature controls violates the inherited Settings floor; retaining flora does not require their char-lace or bloom behaviors.

rows.what: RockBase mineable yields fifteen valuable nonexplosive water-ice items per block; normal item storage/trade; authored scatter zero, placement separate.
rows.called_by: RM_BlueIceMineable.mineableThing and vanilla mining; the optional Thaw comp is a separate callback.
rows.serves: ordinary land
rows.why: Designer decision: Premium water ice is ordinary ground/resource, mined by the normal Mine job; deleting it removes the useful reason to excavate. Water ice is not hydrocarbon fuel.

rows.what: Saved per-map counter, stamped mining pawn, every third enabled mined block rolls 35% for weighted debris; no quarry heat model or Horror release table.
rows.called_by: RM_BlueIceMineable CompProperties_BlueIceThaw -> Notify_BlockMined -> ColdCuttingSuppresses -> weighted loot.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: A global blocks-mined loot roll duplicates wreck salvage and falsely implies careful timing changes safety; ordinary mining needs no roll.
rows.why: Designer decision: A global blocks-mined loot roll duplicates wreck salvage and falsely implies careful timing changes safety; ordinary mining needs no roll.

rows.what: No-power enclosed-room cooling, target controls, real refuelable ice and capped heat/ice spending; idle below target or outdoors; master/feature/capacity settings.
rows.called_by: RM_ColdSinkRack comps; no retained consumer requires RM_CompColdSink.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: Owner's later answer replaces the rack premise with cooling by loose ice; a special fuelled refrigerator duplicates the retained thermal resource.
rows.why: Designer decision: Owner's later answer replaces the rack premise with cooling by loose ice; a special fuelled refrigerator duplicates the retained thermal resource.

rows.what: Deep-blue/clouding/white tint, groan and inspect full-draw hours/working/disabled state. Last printed stage tracks refueling, fixing old stuck-white bug.
rows.called_by: RM_Building_ColdSinkRack.Graphic and RM_CompColdSink; refuel and TickRare dirty the mesh.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: Rack tint, groan and full-draw estimate serve the deferred rack only, not readability of loose ice.
rows.why: Designer decision: Rack tint, groan and full-draw estimate serve the deferred rack only, not readability of loose ice.

rows.what: Campfire/stove bill melts five blocks to three meltwater cans; cans are resources, with FlowWorks potable-water adapter when present.
rows.called_by: RM_MeltBlueIce bill makes RM_BlueIceMeltwaterCan; FlowWorks consumes can and blocks separately.
rows.serves: ordinary land
rows.why: Designer decision: Normal conversion of the excavated water resource makes the ice useful; no bespoke output minigame.

rows.what: Biome carrier uses shared EnvironmentalHazards film: only Haze/unroofed accrues, roof/clear decays, listed ten natives immune. Feature gate stops new application only.
rows.called_by: BiomeDef.biomeMapConditions -> RM_BlueDesertHazeCarrier -> shared EnvironmentalExposure comp.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: A skin/lung severity meter is a second hazard; precipitation remains legible weather without adding an illness.
rows.why: Designer decision: A skin/lung severity meter is a second hazard; precipitation remains legible weather without adding an illness.

rows.what: Odyssey sandRate, storm overlay/ambient and movement/accuracy modifiers; actual accumulation/erosion delegates to vanilla sand grid. Blue-white ground tint remains unbuilt.
rows.called_by: RM_IceSandDrift.sandRate -> Odyssey SandGrid; murrek extension is an optional reader.
rows.serves: ordinary land
rows.why: Designer decision: Accumulation against structures and its travel cost are the ordinary terrain/weather players build and walk through; deleting buildup leaves a painted storm contrary to the explicit deep-drift ruling.

rows.what: Half accuracy, 22.9 range cap, movement slow, fog overlay/ambient and shuttle-launch prevention in the WeatherDef.
rows.called_by: WeatherDef accuracyMultiplier, maxRangeCap and moveSpeedMultiplier; shuttle prevention is separately classified.
rows.serves: ordinary land
rows.why: Designer decision: Obstructed sight/reach and slowed travel are the ordinary fog the colony stands in; deleting these leaves a cosmetic overlay that does not do the ruled weather's job.

rows.what: Biome-local weather commonalities captured once and zeroed/restored by master/feature gate at WriteSettings; no global weather mutation.
rows.called_by: RM_BlueDesertMod.WriteSettings -> RM_BlueDesertWeatherTable.Apply.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: Weather must come and go through the ordinary clock; deleting biome-local controls would leak settings into neighbors or leave kept weather permanently absent.
rows.why: Designer decision: Weather must come and go through the ordinary clock; deleting biome-local controls would leak settings into neighbors or leave kept weather permanently absent.

rows.what: Saved drift transition watcher; idle wild animals seek reachable deep drifts; top-up respects spacing, home/colony clearance, cap and ecosystem-full snapshot.
rows.called_by: RM_MapComponent_MurrekDrifts reads RM_IceSandDrift extension and assigns RM_MurrekBurrow.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: Storm-generated predator top-ups and burial are an independent encounter loop; a visible murrek remains an ordinary predator.
rows.why: Designer decision: Storm-generated predator top-ups and burial are an independent encounter loop; a visible murrek remains an ordinary predator.

rows.what: Burrow/dig/hidden job, saved buried time, nearby prey PredatorHunt, flush on cleared/eroded sand, damage/hunger/rest/timeout/off exits with visibility cleanup and eruption sound.
rows.called_by: RM_JobDriver_MurrekBurrow -> RM_MurrekBuried; Watchers reads that hediff, never creates it.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: Invisibility, burrow jobs and flush behavior form the same extra loop, not required for ordinary predation or fuel detonation.
rows.why: Designer decision: Invisibility, burrow jobs and flush behavior form the same extra loop, not required for ordinary predation or fuel detonation.

rows.what: Biome-only incidents: unlocated crack text, saved hidden marker, timed silhouette plus scavenger convergence/circling, timed payload and letter; ongoing event completes even when disabled.
rows.called_by: IncidentWorker_AblationSalvage creates RM_AblationEmergence; its TickRare summons/circles and exposes.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: Staged timer, silhouette and summoned/circling scavengers add a discovery minigame; physical old sites and salvage meet ancient discovery without it.
rows.why: Designer decision: Staged timer, silhouette and summoned/circling scavengers add a discovery minigame; physical old sites and salvage meet ancient discovery without it.

rows.what: Wreckage and metal bundles plus named fresh-preserved corpse with age text; edge/open/non-home placement. Corpse years are letter flavor, not a simulated age record.
rows.called_by: RM_AblationSalvage_* extensions and RM_AblationEmergence.Expose; AcousticScanner also reads marker.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: Timed metal/wreck/corpse gifts and history letters belong to that incident; ordinary ice-locked wreck salvage stays.
rows.why: Designer decision: Timed metal/wreck/corpse gifts and history letters belong to that incident; ordinary ice-locked wreck salvage stays.

rows.what: Ice-locked hull/frame variants and moderate-density biome GenStep, local spacing and weights; Wreckage owns family loot/weathering/salvage and settings. Ice jacket remains a named gap.
rows.called_by: RM_WreckField_BlueDesert -> Wreckage GenStep; hull/frame inherit Wreckage families and weathering.
rows.serves: ordinary land
rows.why: Designer decision: Without tangible prior attempts the promised ancient secrets reduce to flavor text; retain ordinary frozen salvage and a legible abandoned work site, not timed events.

rows.what: Guarded local scanner targets: emergence, selected animal races, ice-locked wrecks and fogged blue ice, with banded narrative readings supplied by AcousticScanner.
rows.called_by: PatchOperationFindMod attaches RM_AcousticPayloadExtension to native races, wrecks, mineable and deferred emergence.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: A bespoke scanner narrative is another interaction and repeats visible discovery/warnings; neither ordinary scanner engine nor the signature needs local prose.
rows.why: Designer decision: A bespoke scanner narrative is another interaction and repeats visible discovery/warnings; neither ordinary scanner engine nor the signature needs local prose.

rows.what: Owned cold-band port, electric melee, VEF-guarded ranged static arc, owned projectile/art and shared flashstorm death action. No starting hydrocarbon charge/native marker.
rows.called_by: RM_BlueDesert.wildAnimals -> RM_Thunderbeast; inherits normal animal generation.
rows.serves: ordinary life
rows.why: Designer decision: Keep the admitted species and basic ordinary predator behavior; fix its hydrocarbon/native handling mismatch without evicting it. Independent electrical toolkit is split below.

rows.what: Utinni patch adds RSW_Vapaad commonality only while SW Bestiary exists; canon content stays outside the common biome roster file.
rows.called_by: UtinniPatches/Patches/WildAnimals_BlueDesert.xml adds RSW_Vapaad; SWBestiary defines ordinary meat/leather and other wildBiomes.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: The existing campaign patch is retained and not an eviction target; its physiology is a named compatibility conflict, not an inferred exemption from the hydrocarbon rule.
rows.why: Designer decision: The existing campaign patch is retained and not an eviction target; its physiology is a named compatibility conflict, not an inferred exemption from the hydrocarbon rule.

rows.what: RM_ToxiGrass donor-retirement compatibility def/stand-in art still ships; not in current BlueDesert wildPlants. No automatic reintroduction or eviction is inferred.
rows.called_by: Defs/RM_BlueDesert_DonorPorts.xml defines RM_ToxiGrass; no Blue Desert roster caller found.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: Retain dormant donor-save identity; absence from this roster stays deliberate. It contributes no experience and must not be injected.
rows.why: Designer decision: Retain dormant donor-save identity; absence from this roster stays deliberate. It contributes no experience and must not be injected.

rows.what: Persisted master/features and tuning; searchable collapsible scrolling groups, scope labels, per-group reset; flora gates restart, event durations roll at event start, weather applies on settings write.
rows.called_by: RM_BlueDesertMod constructor, ExposeData, UI and all feature call sites.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: The standing floor requires superb persistent per-feature controls and defaults; deleting Settings would make the mod unshippable.
rows.why: Designer decision: The standing floor requires superb persistent per-feature controls and defaults; deleting Settings would make the mod unshippable.

rows.what: Suite, site preflight, plan, fake-game mutation tests, standalone retile/stages/Garden/departure proofs, result-row gate and selftest, compiled pure kernels with seeded fuzz harness.
rows.called_by: northstar_plan.py/northstar_site.py -> validation.py; standalone prove_*; selftest and SelfTest project.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: Existing scripts and pure kernels are useful regression tools, never substitute evidence for the whole mod running.
rows.why: Designer decision: Existing scripts and pure kernels are useful regression tools, never substitute evidence for the whole mod running.

rows.what: FlowWorks already adapts meltwater cans to potable distilled water and has bucket/melter bills for blocks; shared thirst/pipeline engine owns use, not BlueDesert.
rows.called_by: FlowWorks/Patches/Thirst/RM_WaterItems.xml; melter and bucket recipe defs consume RM_BlueIce.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: FlowWorks owns potable distilled water use and ice-to-liquid conversion; need coherent mass accounting, not a new thirst engine.
rows.why: Designer decision: FlowWorks owns potable distilled water use and ice-to-liquid conversion; need coherent mass accounting, not a new thirst engine.

rows.what: ColdStorage already uses qeshra roe in preserved food recipes; source MayRequire is folded at deployment. This widens produce handling beyond raw native feed.
rows.called_by: ColdStorage/Defs/Seals/Seals_Recipes.xml and Seals_Frost.xml reference RM_QeshraRoe.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: Preserved-food manufacture is an independent adapter which can launder reactive native feed into human food; not necessary to native grazing or cold storage.
rows.why: Designer decision: Preserved-food manufacture is an independent adapter which can launder reactive native feed into human food; not necessary to native grazing or cold storage.

rows.what: Campaign NightHorrors already has proximity/temperature-woken crysalises and night-band-gated content; does not itself implement BlueDesert thaw-roll integration.
rows.called_by: UtinniPatches/Source/RUT_NightHorrors.cs; no local BlueDesert mining caller found.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: Existing campaign crysalis/proximity/temperature engine remains owned by NightHorrors; no first-version quarry caller is required or promised.
rows.why: Designer decision: Existing campaign crysalis/proximity/temperature engine remains owned by NightHorrors; no first-version quarry caller is required or promised.

rows.what: Ancient quarry study ladder, permanent hazard-sense/cold-cutting/full reading and shared suppression hook: specified, no local study/unlock implementation and seam returns false.
rows.called_by: No study worker/unlock found; RM_BlueIceThaw.ColdCuttingSuppresses returns false.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: Recommend retiring the technique premise because the later owner answer says ordinary mineral mining; archaeological translations/readings are next-version prose work, not prerequisites.
rows.why: Designer decision: Recommend retiring the technique premise because the later owner answer says ordinary mineral mining; archaeological translations/readings are next-version prose work, not prerequisites.

rows.what: Discoverable ancient quarry/tableau injection and ordinary blue-ice placement; mineable scatter explicitly zero and header leaves placement owed.
rows.called_by: RM_BlueIceMineable scatter is zero; static hull/frame GenStep exists but no authored quarry placement caller located.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: Without discoverable ice and a plain abandoned-work context, ancient secrets and ordinary extraction are only debug-spawned objects. Retain static context, defer epoch/study interactions.
rows.why: Designer decision: Without discoverable ice and a plain abandoned-work context, ancient secrets and ordinary extraction are only debug-spawned objects. Retain static context, defer epoch/study interactions.

rows.what: Quarry thaw table releases and cold-cutting suppression of campaign crysalis danger; neighboring crysalis exists, no mining-roll caller of it located.
rows.called_by: RM_BlueIceThaw has debris-only options; RUT_NightHorrors exists, no cross-call found.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: A campaign siege-form release table is a second hazard and can reuse NightHorrors later; the cold-fuel chain requires no bioweapon.
rows.why: Designer decision: A campaign siege-form release table is a second hazard and can reuse NightHorrors later; the cold-fuel chain requires no bioweapon.

rows.what: Player-controlled pace/face heat and recovery relation before cold-cutting; random blocks-mined roll exists but slower pace itself changes nothing.
rows.called_by: ANSWERS_OWNER.md answer one overrides earlier pace speculation; current Mine/thaw counter has no heat accumulation.

rows.what: Dovvik plant drain, safe-for-a-day state/tint and tame minesweeping job; current def explicitly ships ordinary grazer stub.
rows.called_by: RM_BlueDesertFauna.xml dovvik stub; no drain flag, job or temporary-safe comp found.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: Safe-trail draining and a tame custom minesweeping job are a second safety economy; ordinary tameable native grazing remains life.
rows.why: Designer decision: Safe-trail draining and a tame custom minesweeping job are a second safety economy; ordinary tameable native grazing remains life.

rows.what: Living valve-tap harvest/body-part operation; explicit def stub, no owned worker/job found.

rows.why: Designer decision: A living valve-tap/manhunter trade is a special operation; cold butchery and avoiding EMP already supply the cistern decision.

rows.called_by: BLUEDESERT_MECHANICS_BUILD_1 promises it; no ship-specific local caller located.
rows.serves: See disposition argument: A gravship-specific dig-out tax is additional integration; ordinary drift against structures and cooling in enclosed ship rooms remain.
rows.why: Designer decision: A gravship-specific dig-out tax is additional integration; ordinary drift against structures and cooling in enclosed ship rooms remain.

rows.called_by: BlueDesertLife.cs header explicitly documents missing generated corpse comps; no injection found in src search.

rows.why: Designer decision: A native cannot become safe fuel merely by dying; deleting the fix leaves a bypass in the signature across death/butchery/transport.

rows.what: Ordinary BiofuelRefinery bill converts cold wax to ordinary vanilla Chemfuel. The bill is absent.
rows.evidence: src/RimMandrake/BlueDesert/Defs/ThingDefs_Items/RM_ColdWax.xml; design/Jawa/worldbuilding/creatures/blue_desert_hydrocarbon_life.md section 7; src/RimMandrake/Abyss/Defs/RecipeDefs/RM_Recipes_Chemfuel.xml confirms existing BiofuelRefinery recipe ownership.
